instruction: Candid team photograph, wide shot. In a bright, modern office conference room, four colleagues gather around a white table. From left to right, the blonde woman in the blue dotted blouse (R3), the man in the blue and brown cardigan (R2), the woman in the dark blue dress (R1), and the Black man in the white henley shirt (R4) all lean forward. They smile and laugh as they stack their hands together in a central team huddle over the table. Natural light floods the room from large windows in the background, creating a cheerful, collaborative atmosphere.
elements: R1 contributes her hand to the central team hand stack with R2, R3, and R4 rather than being supported or carried by another person
R4 participates in the shared hand stack with R1, R2, and R3 rather than standing aside as an onlooker
R2 and R3 lean forward to add their hands into the same group huddle rather than one holding a separate target or prop for the other
R1, R2, R3, and R4 all lean forward around the table for a central team huddle
the group stacks their hands together over a white table
the setting is a bright modern office conference room

questions.q: In the team huddle, is R1 adding her own hand to the central stack with R2, R3, and R4, rather than being carried or physically supported by R2?
questions.element: R1 contributes her hand to the central team hand stack rather than being supported or carried by R2

questions.element: R4 participates in the shared hand stack rather than being an onlooker

questions.element: R2 and R3 share the hand-stacking role rather than R2 serving as a prop holder for R3

questions.element: all four labeled colleagues lean forward and participate in the hand-stack huddle
